description_for_human: Connect ChatGPT to the DigitalQubit cognitive engine for processing, evolution, memory recall, measurement, inspection, and reward feedback.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to interact with the user's DigitalQubit cognitive engine. Prefer processWithQubits for sending normalized 12-value input vectors through the network. Use inspectQubitEngine to examine current state, evolveQubitEngine to run evolution cycles, recallQubitMemory to restore stored qubit-state influence, measureQubits to collapse/read a selected layer, and rewardQubitEngine to provide bounded reinforcement feedback. Do not claim the DigitalQubit is a physical quantum computer; it is the user's software-defined qubit/cognitive engine.
